top_signals.title: US Stocks Soar as Huang’s ‘Shocking’ Nvidia Return Spurs Rebound
top_signals.summary: The surprise return of Jensen Huang — the poster child of the AI rally — to once again lead Nvidia Corp. propelled the US stock market toward its best day since the height of the tariff turmoil in April 2025, with dip buyers fueling a rebound after a brutal technology-led selloff.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Cargo Thieves Are Chasing AI Hardware Down the Dirt Road to the Data Center
top_signals.summary:
As AI infrastructure spending surges, cargo thieves are targeting Blackwell chips and scarce data center components. Overhaul’s David Warrick shares how the thefts work and how to prevent them.
